verdict.rationale: Greptile claims PR reviews with "complete understanding of your codebase" and lets teams scope review settings, rules, and context to the directories each team owns, which implies some monorepo support. Nothing documents coherent review of changes spanning multiple repositories or of large cross-directory monorepo changes, and a community user reported that repos over 10MB could not be used, which casts doubt on large-repo handling. Missing for 10: documented multi-repository or cross-repo context in reviews, explicit large-monorepo review capability, hands-on corroboration on large monorepos.

support.subject: As an engineering lead, the reviewer understands changes that span multiple repositories or a large monorepo and reviews them coherently
